verdict.rationale: Wise Business has a public payments API, so scoped API credentials are a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack never documents API token scopes, permission levels, or least-privilege credential issuance. The card spending permissions and MCC-based spend controls govern card transactions, not API credentials, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
